summary: New sense 1b: (mit d-Satz) eine Behandlung verdienen
rationale: A person is the finite subject and the treatment is a d-clause; this differs from an entity or act fitting an l-marked person. One attestation.

summary: example for sense 1b in Infectum (Lahdo Traitor 2/16)

data.turoyo: hawxa xəd ḥa d əmmi: hat ḥaqq hat. Kmaliqat d moḥən kefe ebux yaʕni.
data.translation: as if they wanted to say: it is correct behavior towards you. You deserve to be hit with stones.

rationale: Single personal-treatment construction, finite 2sg subject with a treatment clause.

data.turoyo: Fawqaʕadat ənsan kamilo, ḥaqiqatan kmaləq, d howe rišo di ḥkume d Tərkiya.
data.translation: Er ist ein vollkommener Ehrenmann und wirklich würdig, Oberhaupt der Regierung der Türkei zu sein.

rationale: Unusual personal suitability with a role expressed by d-clause; clarifies passen without making every role a new sense.
Existing examples already contrast suitable partners and proper conduct; 68/56 adds suitability to an office. Make that semantic range explicit without a separate worthy sense.

summary: In both I and III, the suitable entity is ordinarily the subject and the party for whom it fits is expressed by l-, a suffix, eli or laǧani. Stem III here is stative, not automatically a caused event.
Kmaliqat in the treatment construction instead indexes the recipient as 2sg, with a clause specifying what is deserved; retain that explicit difference as 1b.
At 70/109 maləq precedes a feminine noun and a recipient suffix; this alone does not prove an invariant verb. Feminine maliqo occurs elsewhere.
Read-only layəq search found a related adjectival use under tly, not a lyq Part act. box. Arabic-shaped predicates should not automatically enlarge the verbal paradigm.
Source aliases for inherited Prym–Socin quotations are retained; matching occurrences are not added again.
Is the deserve construction with personal subject and d-clause productive beyond the single Lahdo treatment example?
Is layəq at 112/354 a lexical Arabic adjective or a verbal Part act.? No new I box has been published from this provisional analysis.
At 70/109 is maləq before feminine i ḥurmayo due to postposed-subject agreement, suffix contraction or another pattern?
Suitability covers partners, gifts, meals, propriety of conduct and suitability to office; the office d-clause is a participant/role extension rather than a new lexical worthy sense.
